summary: No new record update this turn; the last validated update remains the submission and the current state. Instead, a final integrity check was performed on the generated harness itself, which is the only artifact my later edits touch: all seven TestAssurance probes run together in the scratch copy pass in about ten seconds, covering the main witness series, the joint-membership control, restart recovery through the append path, snapshot resynchronization, the StepDownOnRemoval control, the read-index boundary, and the randomized safety exploration with membership changes injected. The retained artifacts are untouched by those edits, with fifteen fixed-experiment directories preserved exactly as each execution ran them, so every receipt cited in the records can be re-derived from its own fixed basis. The audit stands complete in the record: one asserted defect on the proposal gate for a re-admitted member with ten witness and control receipts, two bounded safety negatives, two resynchronization branches, one authority-transition control, a read-index boundary that confines the harm to the MsgProp entry points, and per-question interpretations carrying the counterevidence, limits and exact indices. I found no further useful work within the remaining budget and will not manufacture additional experiments to consume it.
